comments: Strong passage of birds c800m offshore. Heading SE. Good numbers of young. Small size next to Kittiwakes.

In amongst little gulls, feeding as they moved SE off Car Rocks. Watched for 2-3 minutes. Relatively few Commic terns, no Sandwich seen. Quite noticeable due to small jizz, darker overall plumage, paler breast, dipping flight.
Small chat with reddish flanks and a blue tail.
High over A1 just north of Bilsdean mobbed by crows
Brief views, being constantly chased by a robin. Imm/fem type per other observers who had better views.
one calling at Crow Wood, heard several times clearly. high pitched phyllosc, "tsee-weee"
small arrival, chaffinch-sized with orange scapulars, wing bar and upper breast, white rump, nasal call
As documented. Seen dueling with Chaffinch. Robin-sized but with distinctive white throat patch most distinctive feature.
Females - feeding in same Elderberry tree as 3 Song Thrush.
Hundreds at the mouth of the Esk
Heard then seen briefly near pond
Including 1 beached individual that re-floated on rising tide.
Redhead on river - a 1st for me here.
In off and then west then south again over Brumstame chrixh before changing minds again and down Forth. Pale bellies
Probably way more. All flying south
2 at Barns Ness, 1 at Triangle Wood and 3+ at Vaults Wood
Continuing at Skateraw. Seen in the early morning but incredibly elusive. In total seen for about two seconds.
Flying south - my first of the season
